title: CARTBench: Rubric-Based Evaluation of Shopping Advice for Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines
abstract: arXiv:2611.05862v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Data scarcity, we curate cases from real commercial shopping needs across 17 retail domains, pairing timestamped dialogue with 1,603 product records. For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. The experimental benchmark contains 1,328 expert-annotated criteria across Core, Excellence, and Safety. translated_title: CARTBench：基于评分准则的购物建议评估——面向包含时间线的复杂与模糊请求
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）购物助手如今已能在多轮对话中推荐商品。然而，对其进行可靠评估面临两大难题：数据稀缺与评判标准难以统一。为解决这些障碍，我们推出了针对CART（包含时间线的复杂与模糊请求）的CARTBench基准。针对数据稀缺问题，我们从17个零售领域的真实商业购物需求中精选案例，将带时间戳的对话与1,603条商品记录相配对。针对评判标准难以统一的问题，我们从成功完成订单中人工挑选出的优秀回复里提炼出“理想回复原则”，并以该原则为指导开发了针对具体案例的评分准则。这些原则同样指导了我们的结构化推荐策略——原则引导CART提示。该实验性基准包含1,328条经专家标注的准则，涵盖核心、卓越与安全三个维度。为解答CART问题，我们评估了7个旗舰商用API模型，包括GPT-6.1-Sol等（原文截断）。
tldr: 提出了CARTBench基准，基于真实商业购物订单提炼的评分准则，系统评估LLM购物助手处理包含时间线的复杂与模糊购物请求的能力。
en_tdlr: We introduce CARTBench, a rubric-based benchmark built from real commercial shopping data to systematically evaluate LLM shopping assistants on complex and ambiguous requests with timelines.
